finding: The standalone codec pre-emits canonical LTYPE records. LibreCAD omitted their metadata predeclaration for R12, so a valid nondefault CONTINUOUS flags value caused output to fail in the LTYPE table. A minimal generated control reproduced the failure.
change: Use the existing canonical metadata predeclaration for R12 as well as later versions; the codec still refuses extension dictionary data not representable in R12.
validation: On macOS ARM64, 77 assertions across four standalone cases and 64 assertions across three bundled cases pass. Controls include R12 flags 64, unsupported extension dictionary refusal, unchanged destination, same-filter retry, selected imported HATCH loss reporting and existing hatch/reactor/R12 fallback checks.
limits: Selected locally generated and imported test profiles only. No native or independent R12 producer semantics or broader legacy metadata support claimed; no drawing fixture committed.
